basketball_shot.excessive_forward_lean_a.what: Excessive forward torso lean during release.
basketball_shot.excessive_forward_lean_a.why: Leaning into the shot at release sends horizontal momentum into the ball's flight path, making the shot less consistent.
basketball_shot.excessive_forward_lean_a.whatToChange: Stay vertical through the shot instead of leaning toward the basket.
basketball_shot.excessive_forward_lean_a.cue: Jump upward, not toward the basket.
basketball_shot.excessive_forward_lean_a.drill: Stationary form shooting close to the hoop, focusing on a straight up-and-down jump.
